## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF confirmed. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.07% | 1M: +35.50%) and SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -3.57% | 1M: -7.62%) with TLT RECOVERY (1W: +0.45% | 1M: -4.13%) confirm rising fear and stocks lagging bonds; HYG (1W: -0.79% | 1M: -1.89%) and LQD (1W: -0.23% | 1M: -2.68%) BELOW TREND show credit stress.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear INCREASING: VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.07% | 1M: +35.50%) ↑ rising. Credit stress RISING: HYG/LQD showing weakness with HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.79% | 1M: -1.89%) ↓ falling, and Stocks vs Bonds SPY/TLT ↓ falling with SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -3.57% | 1M: -7.62%) vs TLT RECOVERY (1W: +0.45% | 1M: -4.13%).

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Tighter: Dollar strength rising and above trend (Dollar level ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND) and yield-curve showing RECOVERY (Yield Curve → flat | RECOVERY) while TLT RECOVERY (1W: +0.45% | 1M: -4.13%) signals short-term safe-haven demand against 1M weakness.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.91% | 1M: +11.53%). Tech lagging: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -6.90% | 1M: -8.00%). Style mixed / no clear leadership given broad sector weakness outside energy.

**5. US vs Global?**
Both US and EM under pressure but EM worse: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -3.57% | 1M: -7.62%) and EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -4.47% | 1M: -12.51%); China FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -1.07% | 1M: -6.12%) showing relative resilience vs broader EM.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation contracting: ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -10.43% | 1M: -12.88%) and IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -3.17% | 1M: -8.18%). IBIT in CORRECTION (1W: -5.92% | 1M: +1.32%) — short-term weakness against a small 1M gain.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Broad commodity strength led by oil: USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.43% | 1M: +58.43%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.76% | 1M: +55.10%), while base metals CPER RECOVERY (1W: +0.18% | 1M: -8.92%) and gold GLD RECOVERY (1W: +2.61% | 1M: -14.30%) show uneven moves.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy showing strength: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.91% | 1M: +11.53%) alongside explosive oil ETFs USO/BNO, while natural gas UNG in CORRECTION (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +1.39%) is mixed.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Rising VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.07% | 1M: +35.50%) and SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -3.57% | 1M: -7.62%) plus HYG/LQD weakness confirm a risk-off tone. DIVERGENCE: TLT RECOVERY (1W: +0.45% | 1M: -4.13%) is a short-term bond bounce versus 1M weakness—monitor for reversal.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Reduce exposure to broad equity beta: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -3.57% | 1M: -7.62%) and favor fixed income exposure via TLT RECOVERY (1W: +0.45% | 1M: -4.13%) and commodity/energy exposure via XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.91% | 1M: +11.53%) given relative strength.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.91% | 1M: +11.53%) and oil ETFs USO/BNO if price momentum holds. BEARISH: Technology — XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -6.90% | 1M: -8.00%) and broader cyclicals if credit spreads widen.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Crude oil — USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.43% | 1M: +58.43%) / BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.76% | 1M: +55.10%). BEARISH: Precious metals pressure persists — GLD RECOVERY (1W: +2.61% | 1M: -14.30%) and SLV RECOVERY (1W: +1.68% | 1M: -25.26%).

**13. Key Levels?**
Watch VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.07% | 1M: +35.50%) around elevated levels for risk spikes; monitor HYG (1W: -0.79% | 1M: -1.89%) vs LQD (1W: -0.23% | 1M: -2.68%) for credit deterioration; track XLK/XLE relative performance as a rotation signal.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Energy showing relative strength (XLE ABOVE TREND) while Tech (XLK BELOW TREND) and broader equities (SPY BELOW TREND) are weak; key risk is rising volatility (VXX ABOVE TREND) and credit stress (HYG/LQD weakness) that could deepen market dislocation.
